description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about schedule changes.

files.description: A Confluence page in the customer-policies space for support agents about schedule changes, last updated between 2026-05-26 and 2026-06-30. It must contain these sentences word for word: "Schedule changes of 2 hours or more: a full refund or a free move."; "moved by 2 hours or more before the trip"; "a full refund of the fare and add-ons to the original payment"; "any fare, Basic included". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
